name: Station support and upright stability on a flat desk

assembly.direction: place the station on its flat stable base
assembly.sequence_notes: Use only on a dry, flat indoor desk or shelf.

loads_and_performance.host_load: one closed memo book; exact physical mass not recorded
loads_and_performance.stability_test: 10-degree base tilt after inserting the book

environment_and_variation.surface: dry, flat indoor desk or shelf
environment_and_variation.friction: UNKNOWN until the physical test surface is recorded

keepouts_and_access: Do not claim wall, vehicle, impact, or security retention.
Do not infer anti-slip performance from geometry alone.

evidence.uncertainty_note: The support context and test are specified, but no station geometry, physical desk surface, mass, center of gravity, or stability result exists.

failure_modes.mode: The station tips or slides during ordinary placement.
failure_modes.effect: The book loses its display position and may receive minor cosmetic damage.
failure_modes.mitigation: Preserve a stable base and verify the complete physical prototype on the recorded surface.

acceptance_criteria: With one current Original Kraft book inserted, the station remains upright after a 10-degree base tilt.
